title: RBI Directions: USD-INR Swap Facility Introduced for Fresh FCNR(B) Funds; Excluded from ANBC
summary: RBI introduced USD-INR swap facility for 3-5 year FCNR(B) deposits and excluded fresh FCNR(B)/NRE deposits from ANBC (adjusted net bank credit for priority sector targets) calculation.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Directions: USD-INR Swap Facility Introduced for Fresh FCNR(B) Funds; Excluded from ANBC. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI introduced USD-INR swap facility for 3-5 year FCNR(B) deposits and excluded fresh FCNR(B)/NRE deposits from ANBC (adjusted net bank credit for priority sector targets) calculation.
**Swap Facility Tenor:** US Dollar-Rupee swap facility for fresh FCNR(B) dollar deposits with tenor of **3 to 5 years**.
**CRR/SLR Exemption:** Temporary CRR/SLR relief on fresh FCNR(B) (8 June - 30 Sept 2026) and NRE term deposits (19 June - 30 Sept 2026, 3+ yrs).

**ANBC (adjusted net bank credit for priority sector targets) Exclusion:** Advances against eligible fresh FCNR(B)/NRE deposits excluded from Adjusted Net Bank Credit (ANBC (adjusted net bank credit for priority sector targets)) for PSL calculation.
≠ **ANBC (adjusted net bank credit for priority sector targets) Cap:** Excluded amount cannot exceed eligible fresh FCNR(B)/NRE deposits.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
